response.sql:
WITH film_copy_counts AS (
  SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copy_count
  FROM inventory
  GROUP BY film_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT film_id,
         copy_count,
         copy_count / SUM(copy_count) OVER () AS share_of_inventory,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY copy_count DESC) AS copy_rank
  FROM film_copy_counts
)
SELECT film_id, copy_count, share_of_inventory
FROM ranked
WHERE copy_rank <= 10
ORDER BY copy_count DESC, film_id;

assumptions.assumption: “Top 10” means the 10 highest copy counts, with all films tied at the 10th position included; share is each film’s copy count divided by all inventory records across films.
